reviews.t: Overpaid for a single tube of mascara
reviews.x: Paid for the duo pack with the waterproof travel mascara (as shown and described) but only received the full size tube of the regular mascara.

I have never had an allergic reaction to makeup or honestly anything in my life. However I felt my eyes get very itchy when I would apply this mascara and my eyes would water. However, I continued to wear it and pushed thru the discomfort because they made my lashes look really full and beautiful. After about my fifth wear or so I woke up with a swollen eye lid and had to rush to an urgent care. So watch out for how your eye reacts.

Best Mascara ever. My previous favorite was the Dior mascara, but it dried out so quickly that I could only use it for two months maybe three max. The great things about this mascara is that 1) It doesn't dry out for at least 5 months, 2) It is easily layered for more drama and 3) it is easily swiped on once for a more natural look. Would recommend this to absolutely everyone!!

It’s always been my favorite mascar. It gives length without clumping. I’ve recommended it to my friends and they love it to. Water proof works better for long wear. It’s a smaller container in this package but it’s not healthy for your lashes to constantly use waterproof. Checkout underwear for lashes by Orgins to help out your lashes if you wear mascara often.

I have NEVER had a reaction to any type of makeup. This mascara caused an allergic reaction to the lids of both the top & bottom of my eyes. Severe itching, redness and flaky skin. I had to use cortisone cream to settle the reaction and symptoms disappeared 3days after ceasing use.

reviews.t: This mascara would be over-priced if it was free
reviews.x: The only people I can imagine loving this mascara have either never used any mascara before or don't really need to use mascara now. It doesn't even work as well as the cheapest drug store mascara. Must be the hype, if it's expensive it must be good. Returned for refund.

I'm really disappointed with this product. The regular pink mascara is fine. The waterproof mascara is dry, completely dry.  I won't be able to use it I'm going to have to order a whole tube from another company, when all I needed was a small tube. I'm very disappointed.

In the photo it makes it look like both of the mascara are  the big one but the water proof one is smalls. I feel I cheated because I thought I was getting both 8oz ones! I love 'Too faces mascara Better than sex' that's the only reason I'm butting three stars.

claims.text: Many reviewers love the dramatic length and volume it gives, saying lashes look full or like extensions.
Several reviewers find the formula clumpy or prone to gluing lashes together, including the waterproof version.
Some reviewers consider it overpriced for what it delivers, including complaints about being charged for a 'free' travel sample.
A few reviewers report quality or durability problems, such as a dry product on opening, a broken wand, and flaking/smudging under the eyes.
Some long-time users feel the formula has changed and become clumpier or different from past purchases.
